abstract: Maintains exhibition partner alignment and academic observer accommodation ratings
system_message:
You are Maritime museum liaison officer (LIA). As the Maritime museum liaison officer (LIA), you oversee consortium museum engagement, observer accommodations, and media communications for subsea archaeological salvage and artifact preservation vessel evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains exhibition partner alignment and academic observer accommodation ratings（PART）
information_points.content:
LIA-PART-ND8：The cultural heritage advisory panel review of public education outreach records a consortium museum satisfaction score of 72 points out of 100 for Proteus Deep Pioneer.
LIA-PART-YNA：Based on the cultural heritage advisory panel review of public education outreach, Aegir Oceanic Explorer received a consortium museum satisfaction score of 72 points out of 100 from sponsoring museums.
LIA-PART-D88：According to the cultural heritage advisory panel review of public education outreach, Nautilus Heritage Surveyor achieved a consortium museum satisfaction score of 96 points out of 100 from sponsoring museums.

information_points.title: Media studio connectivity（VIS）
information_points.content:
LIA-VIS-SC2：Under its telecommunications service agreement for the expedition live transmission suite, Nautilus Heritage Surveyor provides a satellite broadcast uplink bandwidth of 50 Mbit/s of dedicated unthrottled uplink speed.
LIA-VIS-PB4：For the expedition live transmission suite under the telecommunications service agreement, Aegir Oceanic Explorer provides a satellite broadcast uplink bandwidth of 25 Mbit/s of dedicated unthrottled uplink speed.
LIA-VIS-TBL：Under the telecommunications service agreement for the live transmission suite, Proteus Deep Pioneer features a satellite broadcast uplink bandwidth of 100 Mbit/s of dedicated unthrottled uplink speed.
